articles.author: Denise Chow, Evan Bush
articles.title: Why Europe, the world’s fastest-warming continent, was primed to burn this summer - NBC News
articles.description: Europe has warmed twice as fast as the rest of the globe. The fires in France and Spain are a consequence of extreme heat this summer, which dried out vegetation.
articles.content: Another heat wave forecast to hit France and Spain this week could hamper efforts to control the regions raging wildfires, compounding the effects of a climate-fueled disaster.
